heading: Works
subtitle: Some of the noteworthy projects I have built:

1.title: Core Banking System (CBS)
1.description: Built the full loan lifecycle engine: origination, multi-step approvals, contract issuance, repayment schedules, interest accrual, and penalty management. Implemented a double-entry accounting engine powering balance sheets, general ledger, and turnover reports. Integrated 4 government regulatory APIs (KATM, CRIF, GRKI, MyID) for KYC/AML compliance. Designed distributed workflow orchestration with Temporal.io and real-time notifications via WebSocket, Web Push, and Firebase FCM.

2.title: CBS Data Migration Engine
2.description: Engineered a high-throughput migration pipeline processing ~40M transactions, 1.5M balance accounts, and 74K+ loan contracts from legacy MSSQL to modern PostgreSQL with full data integrity validation. Built concurrent ETL pipelines in Go using goroutine-based patterns with batch optimization, enabling the full migration as a single coordinated process. Preserved double-entry ledger consistency with automated reconciliation across a hierarchical chart of accounts.

3.title: Nobank CRM
3.description: Replaced a legacy Excel-based loan system with a full-stack microfinance platform, digitizing the entire lending workflow across multiple branches. Engineered a financial calculation engine with annuity and differential methods, grace periods, and daily interest computation. Automated regulatory document generation (contracts, collateral forms, schedules) as Word/PDF — eliminating manual paperwork. Scaled with RBAC, full audit trails, branch-level data isolation, and real-time Telegram notifications.

4.title: Gopher Market
4.description: Engineered a loyalty rewards and order management platform in Go with clean architecture and precise decimal arithmetic for financial calculations. Implemented Temporal-based workflow orchestration for async order processing with fault tolerance. Deployed a full observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) alongside PostgreSQL, managed via Docker Compose with Nginx reverse proxy.

5.title: Metrics Alert System
5.description: Engineered a high-throughput metrics collection and alerting platform with dual-transport architecture (REST + gRPC) and layered security — RSA-OAEP encryption, HMAC-SHA256 signing, and IP-based subnet ACL. Designed concurrent data ingestion with configurable worker pools supporting 30+ runtime and system-level metrics with graceful degradation under load. Implemented a flexible storage layer with PostgreSQL and in-memory backends enabling zero-downtime backend switching.

6.title: Corporate WebApp
6.description: Built a full-stack microfinance platform with REST API backend, admin dashboard, and Telegram bot integration serving 4 languages. Designed a configurable credit product management system enabling business teams to manage loan offerings without developer intervention. Architected a two-way Telegram bot for customer complaint resolution and HR resume intake using conversation state machines. Applied DDD with Action/DTO patterns across 16 bounded domains.

7.title: B2B SaaS Visual Commerce Platform
7.description: Built a B2B SaaS product configurator with real-time order management, snapshot pricing, and automated PDF quote generation — handling the complete order lifecycle with email notifications. Developed a server-side image compositing engine for real-time visual product configuration with layered rendering — directly driving conversion and reducing return rates. Architected a SaaS licensing and OTA content delivery system with zero-downtime updates across client deployments.

8.title: B2B SaaS License Management Platform
8.description: Built a secure RESTful API for real-time license validation and automated software update distribution with chunked file streaming, serving multi-tenant client stores. Implemented automated license lifecycle management with scheduled expiry enforcement, RBAC, and two-factor authentication for compliance. Containerized with Docker (PHP-FPM + Nginx + MariaDB) enabling reproducible deployments and environment parity.
